items.claim: Mackenzie Dern's striking defense is poor.
items.quote: striking defense isn't good at all.

items.claim: Mackenzie Dern possesses high toughness and durability.
items.quote: her durability is there. She's tough.

items.claim: Mackenzie Dern has strong grappling with good transitions and control.
items.quote: As far as grappling goes, she's solid there, too. She's got good transitions, very good control.

items.claim: Mackenzie Dern lacks open-mat takedowns and often has to pull guard.
items.quote: she does lack open-mat takedowns. That's why I said a lot of the time she's just pulling guard

items.claim: Gillian Robertson may be the better striker and could win the fight on the feet.
items.quote: I think like somehow I think Gillian might be the better striker and could win on the feet.
